payload.rationale: The obligation bundles numeric-comparison applicability for Flow, Cyanide Total Recoverable, and TDS under permit NM0028762. The packet grounds report-only Part I limit rows for Cyanide Total Recoverable and Total Dissolved Solids (TDS), which would support REJECT for those parameters under the oracle contract (numeric exceedance comparison not applicable when limits are Report). No packet span establishes the Part I limit type or monitoring basis for Flow. Because the obligation requires adjudicating all three parameters together and neither ACCEPT nor REJECT can be grounded for Flow, the correct disposition is UNRESOLVED rather than inferring report-only status for Flow from absence or from the other parameters.
